# Coffee AI | Core QA User Guide

| Question | Answer |
| --- | --- |
| Which organization is it best for? | Small and medium-sized sales teams that need to increase CRM adoption, and teams that have deployed Salesforce/HubSpot but have insufficient data quality and update discipline. |
| What is the primary problem it solves? | Its main value is AI-first sales CRM, which can be used independently or as an accompanying layer of Salesforce or HubSpot, focusing on eliminating post-entry and post-meeting administrative work. For the purchaser, this positioning should be mapped to quantifiable issues such as data completeness rate, follow-up timeliness rate, scheduling time, or review completion rate. |
| Is it possible to replace the existing core system? | Direct replacements can be assessed if demand is dominated by sales relationships, pipelines and communications, and if existing systems also contain CPQ, finance, services or complex primary data, they should be either complementary or phased. The ecological scale of the new product and regional support are subject to validation; the recording of the meeting is subject to the establishment of an informed consent; and the reference price of $20 is derived from the manufacturer ' s blog and varies from the official offer. |
| How should AI and automation be evaluated? | Don't just watch the demo. Verify with 20—50 real records or one full cycle: input source, recommendation accuracy, manual review points, permissions, failure rollbacks, dosage costs, and audit records. |
| How do you understand public pricing? | The official network published information showing seat-based fees, including unlimited Agent labour, and offered a 14-day trial; the manufacturer's blog disclosed an introductory reference of $20/user/month, but the master pricing page was not made public for the complete package, which was based on a written offer. The open price is only the software entrance, and taxes, minimum numbers, implementation, migration, integration, communications/AI usage and advanced support should enter the TCO for three years. |
| What should I pay attention to when using it in Hong Kong or across regions? | Need to confirm data residency, cross-border transmission, meeting recording consent, email marketing rules, currency and time zone. CRM claims that GDPR/SOC 2 does not automatically satisfy the Hong Kong PDPO. |
| What are the integration priorities? | Priority checks for authentication, mail/calendar or attendance devices, master data direction, API limits, webhooks, error retries, field mappings, historical backfill, and delete synchronization. The "presence" of the interface does not mean that the real-time and governance requirements are met. |
| What is the typical implementation complexity? | Lightweight ranges can be imported and launched with standard templates first; once multi-entity, historical data, complex permissions, bi-directional integration, or statutory calculations are involved, design, cleaning, UAT, parallel operation, training, and post-launch support phases should be set up. |
| What is the minimum safety due diligence question? | Request the latest audit/certification, DPA, subcontractor list, data location, encryption, backup and recovery, RTO/RPO, SSO/SCIM, logs, deletion export mechanism, AI training policy and event notification terms. |
| Can the customer case directly prove the effect? | The official network lists client quotations from ProWest Electric, StoyPath AI, Distyl AI, RevueBase and Fanstake; these qualitative statements for manufacturers are not independent audits. The case can only prove a path of feasibility and cannot be a substitute for interviews with clients on the same scale, in the same area, with the modular POC. |
| What is the recommended POC? | Select a real sales team to verify email/calendar synchronization, deduplication, opportunity updates, automation, reporting, and export for 2—4 consecutive weeks; record weekly manual maintenance time, missed follow-up rate, and AI costs. |
| When is it not recommended? | If critical requirements fall outside its boundaries, contract-level safety/compliance evidence cannot be provided, migration and exit scenarios are unclear, or three-year TCO is out of control with real usage, it is not advisable to procure solely because of the interface or AI demo. |
